conservation_rules: active membership count cannot exceed configured capacity
one population_slot_ref cannot hold duplicate active membership in the same extracurricular
membership changes do not create/delete Academy population
existing valid active memberships consume capacity before new allocation
rules: Materialization or player arrival cannot reorder or reroll an established roster.
A cadet may belong to multiple extracurriculars only when configured membership limits and schedule feasibility allow it.
Membership role does not imply command authority outside the extracurricular context.
